mapper.select: SELECT D.DATNAME AS "name" ,SPLIT_PART(VERSION(), ' on ', 1) AS "version" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM PG_POSTMASTER_START_TIME()) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "startedAt" ,PG_DATABASE_SIZE(D.DATNAME) AS "sizeBytes" ,(SELECT SETTING::INT FROM PG_SETTINGS WHERE NAME = 'max_connections') AS "maxConnections" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PG_STAT_ACTIVITY) AS "allConnections" ,D.NUMBACKENDS AS "connections" ,D.XACT_COMMIT + D.XACT_ROLLBACK AS "xacts" ,D.XACT_ROLLBACK AS "rollbacks" ,D.BLKS_HIT AS "blksHit" ,D.BLKS_READ AS "blksRead" ,D.DEADLOCKS AS "deadlocks" FROM PG_STAT_DATABASE D WHERE D.DATNAME = CURRENT_DATABASE()
SELECT COALESCE(STATE, 'background') AS "state" ,COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM PG_STAT_ACTIVITY WHERE DATNAME = CURRENT_DATABASE() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - QUERY_START))), 0) FROM PG_STAT_ACTIVITY WHERE 1=1 AND DATNAME = CURRENT_DATABASE() AND STATE = 'active' AND PID <> PG_BACKEND_PID()
SELECT RELNAME AS "table" ,PG_TOTAL_RELATION_SIZE(RELID) AS "bytes" ,N_LIVE_TUP AS "rows" FROM PG_STAT_USER_TABLES ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT ID FROM T_USER WHERE ROLE = 'ADMIN' AND DEL_DAY IS NULL
